primarySources.supports: Copilot icon in the lower-right corner; edit/chat/plan modes; platform table (Windows, Mac, web full modes; iPad chat+plan; iPhone/Android chat); note that Copilot may not be included with your subscription or organization settings.

Four eligible license situations; M365 Copilot (Basic)/(Premium) labels; Calculation Options must be Automatic; Unsupported file state causes (SharePoint check-out, Strict Open XML); Copilot in Excel is a Copilot Chat tool and cannot be turned off independently; model choice requires commercial Copilot or Premium.

Last updated July 2026. Two reasons: button moved or license/account; steps: latest build, File > Account > Update License, Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel not supported (use Current or Monthly Enterprise; web works meanwhile), privacy settings Experiences that analyze your content and All connected experiences.

Last updated June 2026. Dynamic Action Button in the corner; rollout April–June 2026 worldwide, GCC/GCC High/DoD from October 2026; Dock; Move to ribbon with Windows Build 16.0.20129.15140+ and macOS Build 16.109.525.2+; shortcuts Alt+C, Cmd+Control+I, F6; only appears for users with Copilot access.

Last updated April 2026. Work account labels Copilot Chat (Basic), M365 Copilot (Basic), M365 Copilot (Premium) with their meanings; personal accounts: only the subscription owner can use Copilot in desktop apps; Services & subscriptions and Windows 11 Start account tile.

COPILOT function no longer available from September 14, 2026; was preview in Frontier and Microsoft 365 Insider programs; cached values remain, recalculation returns #NAME?; use the Copilot pane instead.

Personal accounts only. Enable Copilot checkbox: Windows File > Options > Copilot (Excel Version 2501+), Mac Preferences > Authoring and Proofing Tools > Copilot (16.93.2+); per app, per device, affects everyone on the device; cannot turn off on iOS/Android/web; privacy alternative under Connected experiences.
Last updated September 2026. AI benefits are only available to the subscription owner; credits visible under Services & subscriptions.
Formula completion and Formula by Example are separate checkboxes under File > Options > Copilot (Windows) or Copilot Settings (web); stay off until re-enabled.

Updated 2026-09-30. Rename to Microsoft Copilot; Entra ID required; not available with device-based licensing; Office Feature Updates task must run; *.cloud.microsoft allow-list, copilot.cloud.microsoft, WSS to *.office.com and *.cloud.microsoft, TLS inspection and proxy timeouts; third-party cookies for web; Copilot License Details diagnostic.

Updated 2026-10-01. Copilot Chat eligibility list; admins can limit or block Copilot Chat for users/groups; unpinning does not remove access; Microsoft does not support network-level selective blocking.
